The '''2012–13 California Golden Bears men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. This was head coach [[Mike Montgomery (basketball)|Mike Montgomery]]'s fifth season at California. The Golden Bears played their home games at [[Haas Pavilion]] and participated in the [[2012–13 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 12–6 in Pac-12 play to finish in a three way tie for second place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to Utah. They received an at-large bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]] where they defeated UNLV in the second round before losing in the third round to Syracuse.
